verses.text: अनादृत्य तु तद्वाक्यं रावणः कालचोदितः । जगाम सहमरीचस्तस्याश्रमपदं तदा ॥
verses.english: But then Rāvaṇa, impelled by Time, together with Mārīca, disregarding that speech, went to the hermitage-site of him [Rāma].
verses.gold_issues: DCS splits the नञ् of अनादृत्य (0) and the सह-बहुव्रीहि सहमरीचः (9,10) into separate words; 10 is treated as an epithet of रावणः ("accompanied by Mārīca"). तस्य (11) refers to Rāma and should be Masc, not Neut; पद (13) is neuter, not Masc.

verses.text: तेन मायाविना दूरमपवाह्य नृपात्मजौ । जहार भार्यां रामस्य गृध्रं हत्वा जटायुषम् ॥
verses.english: Having had the two sons of the king drawn far away by that illusionist, [and] having killed the vulture Jaṭāyus, [he] carried off the wife of Rāma.
verses.gold_issues: तेन मायाविना (0,1) is the प्रयोज्यकर्ता (instrumental agent) of the causative absolutive अपवाह्य, marked कर्ता>3. दूरम् (2) is an adverbial accusative (क्रियाविशेषण), marked अव्यय. DCS lemma जटायुष for जटायुस्.

verses.text: गृध्रं च निहतं दृष्ट्वा हृतां श्रुत्वा च मैथिलीम् । राघवः शोकसंतप्तो विललापाकुलेन्द्रियः ॥
verses.english: Having seen the vulture slain, and having heard that Maithilī [was] carried off, Rāghava, burning with grief, his senses agitated, lamented.
verses.gold_issues: निहतम् (2) and हृताम् (4) are predicative (object complements of दृष्ट्वा / श्रुत्वा), marked विशेषण.

verses.text: ततस्तेनैव शोकेन गृध्रं दग्ध्वा जटायुषम् । मार्गमाणो वने सीतां राक्षसं संददर्श ह ॥
verses.english: Then, having burned the vulture Jaṭāyus in that very grief, [Rāma], searching for Sītā in the forest, saw a Rākṣasa.
verses.gold_issues: मार्गमाणः (7) qualifies the unexpressed subject of संददर्श; with no noun to attach to it is given head = the finite verb (11) as विशेषण.

verses.text: कबन्धं नाम रूपेण विकृतं घोरदर्शनम् । तं निहत्य महाबाहुर्ददाह स्वर्गतश्च सः ॥
verses.english: Having slain him, named Kabandha, deformed in form, of dreadful appearance, the mighty-armed [Rāma] burned [him]; and he went to heaven.
verses.gold_issues: रूपेण (2) is an instrumental of respect (इत्थंभूतलक्षण) completing विकृतम्. स्वर्गतः (11) is kept by DCS as one lexicalised word (स्वः गतः); used as the verbal predicate of the second clause. दर्शनम् (5) as a bahuvrihi member is fine as Masc.

verses.text: स चास्य कथयामास शबरीं धर्मचारिणीम् । श्रमणीं धर्मनिपुणामभिगच्छेति राघव । सो ऽभ्यगच्छन्महातेजाः शबरीं शत्रुसूदनः ॥
verses.english: And he told him: "Rāghava, go to Śabarī, the female ascetic who practises dharma, skilled in dharma." He, of great splendour, the destroyer of enemies, went to Śabarī.
verses.gold_issues: अस्य (2) is a genitive used for the dative of the person told (षष्ठी for चतुर्थी), marked सम्प्रदान. The quoted clause (9 with इति) is treated as a subordinate क्रिया under कथयामास. DCS gives form श्रमणाम्/lemma श्रमणा but text reads श्रमणीम्; vocative form shown as राघवैस् (should be राघव). धर्मचारिणी is kept as one word by DCS.

verses.text: शबर्या पूजितः सम्यग्रामो दशरथात्मजः । पम्पातीरे हनुमता संगतो वानरेण ह ॥
verses.english: Rāma, son of Daśaratha, [was] duly honoured by Śabarī; on the bank of the Pampā [he] met with the monkey Hanumān.
verses.gold_issues: Two क्त predicates: पूजितः (passive, रामः its कर्म) and संगतः (intransitive, unexpressed subject Rāma). हनुमता (8) is an instrumental of accompaniment. DCS form/lemma हनुमन्ता/हनुमन्त् for हनुमत्.

verses.text: हनुमद्वचनाच्चैव सुग्रीवेण समागतः । सुग्रीवाय च तत्सर्वं शंसद्रामो महाबलः ॥
verses.english: And on the very word of Hanumān, mighty Rāma met with Sugrīva, and [was] telling Sugrīva all that.
verses.gold_issues: DCS reads शंसत् as the present participle शंसन्; it may instead be an augmentless (ārṣa) imperfect अशंसत्, which would make line 2 a separate finite clause. Followed DCS. सुग्रीवेण (4) instrumental of accompaniment with समागतः.

verses.text: ततो वानरराजेन वैरानुकथनं प्रति । रामायावेदितं सर्वं प्रणयाद्दुःखितेन च । वालिनश्च बलं तत्र कथयामास वानरः ॥
verses.english: Then by the king of monkeys, distressed too, everything was told to Rāma out of affection, regarding the recounting of the enmity; and there the monkey told of Vālin's strength.
verses.gold_issues: Convention added: an accusative governed by the कर्मप्रवचनीय प्रति is marked कर्म>प्रति, and प्रति is अव्यय>verb. आवेदितम् is passive क्त, so सर्वम् (nom) is its कर्म.

verses.text: प्रतिज्ञातं च रामेण तदा वालिवधं प्रति । सुग्रीवः शङ्कितश्चासीन्नित्यं वीर्येण राघवे ॥
verses.english: And then it was promised by Rāma regarding the slaying of Vālin; and Sugrīva was ever doubtful about Rāghava as to [his] prowess.
verses.gold_issues: प्रतिज्ञातम् (0) is an impersonal (भावे) क्त, Nom Neut Sing; DCS tags it Acc Masc. वीर्येण (12) instrumental of respect with शङ्कितः.

verses.text: राघवः प्रत्ययार्थं तु दुन्दुभेः कायमुत्तमम् । पादाङ्गुष्ठेन चिक्षेप सम्पूर्णं दशयोजनम् ॥
verses.english: But Rāghava, for the sake of proof, with his big toe flung the huge body of Dundubhi a full ten yojanas.
verses.gold_issues: प्रत्ययार्थम् (2) and दशयोजनम् (11, accusative of distance) are adverbial accusatives, marked अव्यय (same convention as दूरम् in v42). सम्पूर्णम् (9) tagged Masc by DCS though it qualifies neuter दशयोजनम्; it could also agree with कायम्. पादाङ्गुष्ठ kept as one word.

verses.text: बिभेद च पुनः सालान्सप्तैकेन महेषुणा । गिरिं रसातलं चैव जनयन्प्रत्ययं तदा ॥
verses.english: And again, then producing conviction, [he] pierced seven sāla trees with a single great arrow, and the mountain and the netherworld too.
verses.gold_issues: जनयन् (12) qualifies the unexpressed subject and is attached to the finite verb (as in v44). सप्त (4) tagged Neut Sing by DCS; it is an indeclinable-like numeral agreeing with सालान्.

verses.text: ततः प्रीतमनास्तेन विश्वस्तः स महाकपिः । किष्किन्धां रामसहितो जगाम च गुहां तदा ॥
verses.english: Then he, the great monkey, glad in mind, reassured by him, accompanied by Rāma, went then to Kiṣkindhā, the cave.
verses.gold_issues: गुहाम् (13) taken as apposition to किष्किन्धाम्.

verses.text: ततो ऽगर्जद्धरिवरः सुग्रीवो हेमपिङ्गलः । तेन नादेन महता निर्जगाम हरीश्वरः ॥
verses.english: Then Sugrīva, best of monkeys, tawny like gold, roared; at that great roar the lord of monkeys [Vālin] came out.
verses.gold_issues: हरिवर (2) kept by DCS as one word (हरीणां वरः). नादेन (7) instrumental of cause. हेमपिङ्गलः is an उपमान-कर्मधारय.

verses.text: ततः सुग्रीववचनाद्धत्वा वालिनमाहवे । सुग्रीवमेव तद्राज्ये राघवः प्रत्यपादयत् ॥
verses.english: Then, at Sugrīva's word, having slain Vālin in battle, Rāghava installed Sugrīva himself in that kingdom.
verses.gold_issues: तत् (8) is tagged Acc Neut by DCS, but तद्राज्ये is a compound (तस्य राज्ये, "in his kingdom"); marked सम्बन्ध>9 and translated "that kingdom".

verses.text: स च सर्वान्समानीय वानरान्वानरर्षभः । दिशः प्रस्थापयामास दिदृक्षुर्जनकात्मजाम् ॥
verses.english: And he, the bull among monkeys, desiring to see Janaka's daughter, having assembled all the monkeys, sent [them] forth to the quarters.
verses.gold_issues: दिशः (7) is the destination with a verb of motion (गत्यर्थ कर्म). जनकात्मजा kept as one word by DCS. जनकात्मजाम् is the object of the desiderative adjective दिदृक्षुः.

verses.text: ततो गृध्रस्य वचनात्सम्पातेर्हनुमान्बली । शतयोजनविस्तीर्णं पुप्लुवे लवणार्णवम् ॥
verses.english: Then, at the word of the vulture Sampāti, the mighty Hanumān leapt across the salt ocean, extending a hundred yojanas.
verses.gold_issues: DCS form हनुमन्त् for हनुमान्. लवणार्णव kept as one word. गृध्रस्य (1) is in apposition to सम्पातेः.

verses.text: तत्र लङ्कां समासाद्य पुरीं रावणपालिताम् । ददर्श सीतां ध्यायन्तीमशोकवनिकां गताम् ॥
verses.english: There, having reached Laṅkā, the city guarded by Rāvaṇa, [he] saw Sītā, brooding, gone into the Aśoka grove.
verses.gold_issues: DCS form ध्यायतीम् for text ध्यायन्तीम्.

verses.text: निवेदयित्वाभिज्ञानं प्रवृत्तिं च निवेद्य च । समाश्वास्य च वैदेहीं मर्दयामास तोरणम् ॥
verses.english: Having presented the token of recognition, and having reported the news, and having comforted Vaidehī, [Hanumān] smashed the gateway.

verses.text: पञ्च सेनाग्रगान्हत्वा सप्त मन्त्रिसुतानपि । शूरमक्षं च निष्पिष्य ग्रहणं समुपागमत् ॥
verses.english: Having slain the five army-leaders and also the seven sons of ministers, and having crushed the hero Akṣa, [he] submitted to capture.
verses.gold_issues: पञ्च (0) is tagged Nom by DCS; it agrees with accusative सेनाग्रगान्. अग्रग is kept as one word (itself an उपपद compound अग्रे गच्छति).

verses.text: अस्त्रेणोन्मुहमात्मानं ज्ञात्वा पैतामहाद्वरात् । मर्षयन्राक्षसान्वीरो यन्त्रिणस्तान्यदृच्छया ॥
verses.english: The hero, knowing himself [released from the weapon] by virtue of the boon of the Grandfather, [was] willingly bearing with those Rākṣasas who had bound [him].
verses.gold_issues: DCS word list omits अस्त्रेण उन्मुहम् (text अस्त्रेणोन्मुहम्, probably a corruption of उन्मुक्तम्); supplied in brackets in English only. मर्षयन् (4) is tagged Voc; it is Nom, and as the only verbal form it is the predicate. वरात् (3) "boon" is a noun, not ADJ; पैतामहात् (2) is adjectival ("of Brahmā"). यदृच्छया instrumental of manner.

verses.text: ततो दग्ध्वा पुरीं लङ्कामृते सीतां च मैथिलीम् । रामाय प्रियमाख्यातुं पुनरायान्महाकपिः ॥
verses.english: Then, having burned the city Laṅkā except Maithilī Sītā, the great monkey came back to tell Rāma the pleasing [news].
verses.gold_issues: सीताम् (5) is an (ārṣa) accusative with ऋते, which normally takes the ablative; marked कर्म>ऋते like the प्रति construction (v49).

verses.text: सो ऽभिगम्य महात्मानं कृत्वा रामं प्रदक्षिणम् । न्यवेदयदमेयात्मा दृष्टा सीतेति तत्त्वतः ॥
verses.english: He, of immeasurable spirit, having approached the great-souled Rāma and having made [him] the object of circumambulation, reported truly: "Sītā has been seen."
verses.gold_issues: Text reads तत्त्वतः (adverb, तसिल्), DCS gives तत्त्वात् Abl; marked अव्यय. महात्मानम् (2) is the object of अभिगम्य as well; attached to रामम्. प्रदक्षिणम् (5) is predicative. The quote दृष्टा सीता is a passive क्त clause (सीता = कर्म) under न्यवेदयत्.

verses.text: ततः सुग्रीवसहितो गत्वा तीरं महोदधेः । समुद्रं क्षोभयामास शरैरादित्यसंनिभैः ॥
verses.english: Then, accompanied by Sugrīva, having gone to the shore of the great ocean, [Rāma] agitated the sea with arrows resembling the sun.
verses.gold_issues: सुग्रीवसहितः (2) qualifies the unexpressed subject; attached to the finite verb (as v44).

verses.text: दर्शयामास चात्मानं समुद्रः सरितां पतिः । समुद्रवचनाच्चैव नलं सेतुमकारयत् ॥
verses.english: And the ocean, lord of rivers, showed himself; and on the very word of the ocean [Rāma] had Nala build a bridge.
verses.gold_issues: नलम् (10) is the प्रयोज्यकर्ता of causative अकारयत् in the accusative (हृक्रोरन्यतरस्याम्), marked कर्म.

verses.text: तेन गत्वा पुरीं लङ्कां हत्वा रावणमाहवे । अभ्यषिञ्चत्स लङ्कायां राक्षसेन्द्रं विभीषणम् ॥
verses.english: Having gone by that [bridge] to the city Laṅkā, having slain Rāvaṇa in battle, he consecrated Vibhīṣaṇa in Laṅkā as lord of the Rākṣasas.
verses.gold_issues: तेन (0) refers to the bridge (सेतु) of v65. राक्षसेन्द्रम् (11) is a predicative complement of अभ्यषिञ्चत्.

verses.text: कर्मणा तेन महता त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् । सदेवर्षिगणं तुष्टं राघवस्य महात्मनः ॥
verses.english: The three worlds, with [all] moving and unmoving beings, together with the hosts of gods and seers, [were] pleased by that great deed of the great-souled Rāghava.
verses.gold_issues: DCS splits the सह-बहुव्रीहि सदेवर्षिगणम् (स + देवर्षिगणम्) and tags गणम् Acc Masc; it is Nom Neut, agreeing with त्रैलोक्यम्. सचराचरम् is kept as one word. तुष्टम् is a कर्तरि क्त predicate.

verses.text: तथा परमसंतुष्टैः पूजितः सर्वदैवतैः । कृतकृत्यस्तदा रामो विज्वरः प्रमुमोद ह ॥
verses.english: Thus honoured by all the deities, supremely pleased, Rāma, his task accomplished, free from distress, then rejoiced.
verses.gold_issues: कृतकृत्य (6) is a lexicalised bahuvrihi (कृतं कृत्यं येन सः) kept as one word. सर्वदैवतैः (5) is the instrumental agent of the passive participle पूजितः.

verses.text: देवताभ्यो वरान्प्राप्य समुत्थाप्य च वानरान् । पुष्पकं तत्समारुह्य नन्दिग्रामं ययौ तदा ॥
verses.english: Having obtained boons from the deities, and having raised up the monkeys, having mounted that Puṣpaka, [he] then went to Nandigrāma.
verses.gold_issues: देवताभ्यः (0) is ablative (source with प्र-आप्), DCS tags Dat. प्राप्य lemma should be प्राप्, not causative प्रापय्. तत् (7) tagged Neut against Masc पुष्पकम्.

verses.text: नन्दिग्रामे जटां हित्वा भ्रातृभिः सहितो ऽनघः । रामः सीतामनुप्राप्य राज्यं पुनरवाप्तवान् ॥
verses.english: In Nandigrāma, having cast off [his] matted locks, the sinless Rāma, accompanied by his brothers, having regained Sītā, obtained the kingdom again.
verses.gold_issues: DCS form अवाप्तवन् for अवाप्तवान् (क्तवतु predicate, marked क्रिया).

verses.text: प्रहृष्टमुदितो लोकस्तुष्टः पुष्टः सुधार्मिकः । निरायमो अरोगश्च दुर्भिक्षभयवर्जितः ॥
verses.english: The world [will be] delighted and glad, content, well-nourished, very righteous, [free from affliction] and free from disease, devoid of the fear of famine.
verses.gold_issues: DCS word list omits निरायमः (text निरायमो); supplied in English in brackets only. सुधार्मिकः is split into सु + धार्मिकः. The verbless nominal clause is taken as future, in line with v72.

verses.text: न पुत्रमरणं केचिद्द्रक्ष्यन्ति पुरुषाः क्वचित् । नार्यश्चाविधवा नित्यं भविष्यन्ति पतिव्रताः ॥
verses.english: No men at all will anywhere see the death of a son, and women, devoted to their husbands, will always be un-widowed.
verses.gold_issues: अविधवा and पतिव्रता kept as single words (नञ्-तत्पुरुष / बहुव्रीहि). पतिव्रताः taken as attributive, अविधवाः as the complement of भविष्यन्ति.

verses.text: न वातजं भयं किंचिन्नाप्सु मज्जन्ति जन्तवः । न चाग्रिजं भयं किंचिद्यथा कृतयुगे तथा ॥
verses.english: There [will be] no fear at all born of wind; creatures do not drown in the waters; nor [will there be] any fear [born of fire]; as in the Kṛta age, so [it will be].
verses.gold_issues: DCS word list omits च and अग्निजम् (text चाग्रिजं, a misprint for चाग्निजं); supplied in brackets in English. In the verbless negative clauses न is attached to the subject. यथा … तथा: the locative कृतयुगे is attached to यथा, and तथा to the clause before it.

verses.text: अश्वमेधशतैरिष्ट्वा तथा बहुसुवर्णकैः । गवां कोट्ययुतं दत्त्वा विद्वद्भ्यो विधिपूर्वकम् ॥
verses.english: Having sacrificed with hundreds of horse-sacrifices, and likewise with [sacrifices] abounding in gold, having given to the learned, according to rule, ten thousand crores of cows, …
verses.gold_issues: The sentence's finite verb (स्थापयिष्यति) is in v75; the last absolutive दत्त्वा takes head '-' and इष्ट्वा is chained to it. DCS form of 12 is empty (should be पूर्वकम्, adverbial acc.) and 10 has form विद्वोभ्यस् for विद्वद्भ्यः. बहुसुवर्णकैः is a bahuvrihi adjective qualifying understood यज्ञैः, tagged NOUN.

verses.text: राजवंशाञ्शतगुणान्स्थापयिष्यति राघवः । चातुर्वर्ण्यं च लोके ऽस्मिन्स्वे स्वे धर्मे नियोक्ष्यति ॥
verses.english: Rāghava will establish royal dynasties a hundredfold, and in this world [he] will engage the four varṇas each in its own dharma.
verses.gold_issues: शतगुण (2) kept as one word. स्वे स्वे is a distributive repetition (वीप्सा).

verses.text: दशवर्षसहस्राणि दशवर्षशतानि च । रामो राज्यमुपासित्वा ब्रह्मलोकं गमिष्यति ॥
verses.english: Rāma, having ruled the kingdom for ten thousand years and ten hundred years, will go to the world of Brahmā.
verses.gold_issues: The time-duration accusatives (2, 5) are adverbial, marked अव्यय (convention as v42/v51). Outer relation of दश-वर्षसहस्राणि taken as संख्या-कर्मधारय (not a समाहार द्विगु).

verses.text: इदं पवित्रं पापघ्नं पुण्यं वेदैश्च संमितम् । यः पठेद्रामचरितं सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते ॥
verses.english: This [is] purifying, sin-destroying, meritorious, and equal to the Vedas; whoever would read the deeds of Rāma is released from all sins.
verses.gold_issues: सर्वपापैः (13) is instrumental with passive प्रमुच्यते (sense "from"); marked करण by case. The correlative सः of the main clause is unexpressed. पवित्र is tagged NOUN; it is adjectival here.

verses.text: एतदाख्यानमायुष्यं पठन्रामायणं नरः । सपुत्रपौत्रः सगणः प्रेत्य स्वर्गे महीयते ॥
verses.english: A man reading this life-giving narrative, the Rāmāyaṇa, together with sons and grandsons, together with his retinue, having departed [this life], is exalted in heaven.
verses.gold_issues: DCS splits the सह-बहुव्रीहि सपुत्रपौत्रः and सगणः into स + member (as v67); स (6, 9) attached as अव्यय to the following word.

verses.text: पठन्द्विजो वागृषभत्वमीयात्स्यात्क्षत्रियो भूमिपतित्वमीयात् । वणिग्जनः पण्यफलत्वमीयाज्जनश्च शूद्रो ऽपि महत्त्वमीयात् ॥
verses.english: Reading [it], a Brahmin would attain eminence in speech; should one be a Kṣatriya, he would attain lordship of the earth; the merchant folk would attain profit from their wares; and a person, even a Śūdra, would attain greatness.
verses.gold_issues: DCS treats the taddhita -त्व as a separate compound member (वागृषभ+त्व, भूमिपति+त्व) yet keeps पण्यफलत्वम् and महत्त्वम् whole; vigrahas given as भाव-abstracts. स्यात् (5) read as a conditional copula ("should he be"), attached to ईयात् (9). Verse is in Upajāti metre (not anuṣṭubh).
